content:
Solve \(k^2\equiv 1\pmod{291}\), with \(291=3\cdot 97\).

Modulo \(3\): \(k\equiv \pm1\pmod 3\).
Modulo \(97\): \(k\equiv \pm1\pmod{97}\).

Combining the four CRT cases modulo \(291\):
\[
k\equiv 1,\ 98,\ 193,\ 290 \pmod{291}.
\]

Since
\[
291000 = 291\cdot 1000,
\]
each residue class modulo \(291\) appears exactly \(1000\) times among \(1,\dots,291000\).

Thus the total number is
\[
4\cdot 1000 = 4000.
\]

\[
\boxed{4000}
\]
